== Summary ==
Identified: [[Jared Napolitano]] (center, green Eagles cap and Players Committee polo). Remaining faces unlabeled: opponent in a grey long-sleeve shirt and a black mask (same man as [[:File:2021 World Championship feature table game 7.jpg]] and [[:File:2021 World Championship feature table game 6.jpg]]), and two players at the far table.
A game at the feature table. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2021:10:08 02:03:10 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-19
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brandon Baity]] ("Here are most of the pictures I took during the weekend", forum post 1356914)
